evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Frames operational safety and capability as real only when actively practiced and verified.

mints.name: RehearsedCapabilityOnly
mints.title: a capability not rehearsed is not actually had
mints.frame: Does the expression insist that safety mechanisms or capabilities are illusory unless actively verified through practice?
